name: rehype-sanitize
notes: Schema-based sanitizer for the unified/rehype pipeline. Built on hast-util-sanitize 5.0.2. Stable but no release since 2023, and it only applies to HAST, not raw HTML strings.

build_vs_buy.effort: weeks to get a correct schema; the engine is the hard part
build_vs_buy.rationale: Schema-based sanitisation is small in code and expensive in correctness; buy the engine.
